source.value: SBA did not flag all PPP loans referred by lenders as suspected of fraud or illegal activity because OCRM wanted to validate the referred loan information with the lenders first. According to OCRM officials, when they initially requested the suspicious loan information from lenders, they did not consider that lenders may submit loans that were previously considered potentially fraudulent, but subsequently cleared. OCRM did not have assurance that the referred loans were still potentially fraudulent as it only requested that lenders provide the following for all loans the lenders suspected of fraud or illegal activity: e Loan number e Loan was/was not reported to SBA OIG
